how_it_works.heading: Our interview process road
how_it_works.desc: Three simple steps to go from applicant to hired. Speak2hire handles the heavy lifting — you focus on showing your best self.

step1.title: Upload Your CV
step1.desc: Drop your CV into our platform. Our AI reads it instantly and builds a personalized interview tailored to your background and target role.

step2.title: Record Your Interview
step2.desc: Answer AI-generated questions using your voice. No scheduling, no pressure — practice as many times as you need.

step3.title: Get Your Analysis
step3.desc: Receive a full performance report with scores, feedback, and actionable tips to improve your answers and land the job.

faq.section_subtitle: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our AI platform.

q1.q: How does the AI analyze my CV?
q1.a: Our AI scans your CV for skills, experience, and achievements, then provides personalized suggestions for improvement.

q2.a: Yes! We use advanced encryption and secure cloud storage to ensure your data is completely safe.

q3.q: Can I try the platform for free?
q3.a: Absolutely! We offer a free trial so you can explore the features before subscribing.

q4.q: How accurate is the AI interview analysis?
q4.a: Our AI uses advanced machine learning models trained on thousands of interview cases to provide highly accurate insights.

q5.q: Can I share my results with employers?
q5.a: Yes! You can export your CV and interview analysis reports to share with potential employers easily.
